_note: Mechanism: unspoken rule. Nobody agreed the group chat name is permanent, but changing it is now a social act with consequences.

premise.situation: A group chat has been named after a single joke from a night out in 2019
premise.turn: Nobody can rename it because renaming it would mean admitting you think about it
premise.detail: the name is a misspelling nobody has ever explained

character_sheet: a woman in her late twenties, dark bob, oversized jumper, holding a phone

beats.text: My group chat has been called the same thing since twenty nineteen.
It is a misspelling of a word. From a night none of us fully remember.
Six adults with mortgages open that name every single day.
Someone changed it once. For nine minutes. Then it was back.
No discussion. Nobody said anything. It was simply back.
I have thought about changing it. Then I picture everyone seeing that I did.
So it stays. We will be sixty and it will still say that.
